title: LDL Factorization
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Math Functions/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Factorizations/LDL_Factorization.md
text: Factor square Hermitian positive definite matrices into lower, upper, and diagonal components, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Method of rounding operation; {Non-positive definite input}, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Intermediate product}, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {Output}, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum value that block can output, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum value that block can output and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Non-positive definite input
params.values: Non-positive definite input action Warning (default) | Ignore | Error

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Method of rounding operation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Intermediate product
params.values: Intermediate product data type Inherit: Same as input (default) | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Same as input (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output Minimum
params.values: Minimum value that block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output Maximum
params.values: Maximum value that block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
